headings: Placing Customer Places a Sales Order - Through CSR
text: If Customer is a new organization that wants to purchase on credit, CSR creates Party (using new customer) for Customer and Billing Account with a beginning limit determined by Company. Customer sends copy of their internal Purchase Order by fax (possibly scan/email or mail) with certain required information/etc. If Customer does not specify email address CSR enters dummy address that will receive confirmations. CSR enters a sales order for the PO with the Billing Account instead of a payment method, and approves the order.
limitation: Read-only screen/dialog evidence only. Prerequisite creation, field input, submissions, integrations and full story transitions are not executed.
